desc: Derive fixed-`H` interval model, cost independence of split, monotonicity, and binary-search approach.
Implement the complete Python solution: fast stdin parsing, `feasible(H)` interval propagation, binary search for maximum feasible integer `H`, and output `total_sum - N*best_H`.
Validate edge cases: already fitting answer 0, `X=0`, one small `U_i+D_i` capping `H`, `H=0` fallback, and large 64-bit/sample-3-style values.
Confirm final complexity is `O(N log 1e9)` time and `O(N)` input storage or better.
